# Aimmers Nepal

> Free timed mock-test platform for schools and tuition centres in Nepal.
> Teachers upload question banks (PDF, Word, TXT or photos of papers),
> students take timed multiple-choice tests, and an AI assistant explains
> every answer afterwards.

## What this site offers

- Students: timed mock tests with a countdown, instant scores, pass/fail
  verdicts, AI explanations for every question, and a study assistant that
  helps with class topics (Math, Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology,
  English, Nepali, Social Studies, Computer).
- Teachers: upload question banks, review and approve extracted questions,
  create tests (question count, time limit, passing percentage) from one or
  many banks, and see student results.
- Data privacy: student data is stored in a private database; assistant
  chat history is never saved.

## Key public pages

- [Home / landing page](/): overview for students and teachers, demo
  accounts, how it works.
- [Sign in](/login): one sign-in page for all roles (students, teachers,
  admins).
- [Register](/register): students can create their own account; teacher and
  admin accounts are created by the school's admin.

## Facts

- Name: Aimmers Nepal
- Audience: school students (primary), teachers, one admin per school
- Question format: multiple choice, 1 mark per question, exact wording from
  the teacher's uploaded document
- Contact: +977 981-5339848
